verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an official CLI (snyk-gh-1/2/3/4/5) with documented install and usage, confirmed hands-on via probes (snyk-probe-4, snyk-probe-5, snyk-probe-7), and it supports agentic workflows directly, e.g. `snyk fix --agentic`, an embedded MCP server accessible via `snyk mcp`, and slash commands for coding assistants (snyk-docs-13, snyk-docs-23, snyk-probe-6). This directly satisfies the AI-native CLI story with both docs and independent verification. Missing for 10: fully unauthenticated/local-only scanning (probe shows auth required for `snyk test`), and no independent third-party review specifically praising the CLI's AI-native ergonomics.
